import os
import json
import datetime
import requests

def post_flag_change_to_slack(flag_key, environment, previous_value, new_value, changed_by):
    slack_webhook_url = os.environ['FLAG_CHANGES_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL']
    environment_emoji_by_name = {'production': ':red_circle:', 'staging': ':large_yellow_circle:'}
    environment_emoji = environment_emoji_by_name.get(environment, ':white_circle:')
    announcement_headline = f'{environment_emoji} Flag `{flag_key}` changed in *{environment}*'
    announcement_detail_text = f'`{previous_value}` → `{new_value}` (by {changed_by})'
    slack_message_payload = {'text': f'{announcement_headline}: {announcement_detail_text}', 'blocks': [{'type': 'section', 'text': {'type': 'mrkdwn', 'text': announcement_headline}}, {'type': 'context', 'elements': [{'type': 'mrkdwn', 'text': announcement_detail_text}]}]}
    slack_http_response = requests.post(slack_webhook_url, json=slack_message_payload, timeout=10)
    slack_http_response.raise_for_status()
    # Record the announced change in a local append-only history file
    flag_change_history_path = os.environ.get('FLAG_CHANGE_HISTORY_PATH', 'flag_change_history.jsonl')
    flag_change_record = {
        'announced_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'flag_key': flag_key,
        'environment': environment,
        'previous_value': previous_value,
        'new_value': new_value,
        'changed_by': changed_by,
    }
    with open(flag_change_history_path, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as history_file:
        history_file.write(json.dumps(flag_change_record) + '\n')
    return {'posted': True, 'flag_key': flag_key, 'environment': environment, 'slack_status_code': slack_http_response.status_code}
